national_news.title: Parliament passes Taxation and Other Laws Amendment Bill to enhance ease of doing business
bullets: The Bill seeks to amend the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, the Income-tax Act, 2025, and the Finance Act, 2026.
The bill will replace the Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026, which was promulgated on 5th June this year.
The Ordinance was promulgated with the objective of mitigating the impact of external economic shocks.

national_news.title: Parliament Passes Bankers' Books Evidence Bill, 2026 for Digital Banking Records
bullets: The Bankers' Books Evidence Bill, 2026 aims to modernise the legal framework for banking.
The Bill seeks to provide a law relating to evidence with respect to bankers' books and align it with contemporary digital banking practices.
An electronic or digital record of a banker's book will be admissible as evidence under the new law.

national_news.title: 80th Independence Day Celebrations to Highlight Yuva Shakti and 150 Years of Vande Mataram
bullets: The 80th Independence Day celebrations will focus on Yuva Shakti and young India's contribution to building a Viksit Bharat by 2047.
The celebrations will commemorate 150 years of the National Song, Vande Mataram.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will lead the celebrations from the historic Red Fort and address the nation.

national_news.title: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju Urges Opposition to Allow LS to Function for HM Amit Shah's Statement
bullets: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju assured that Home Minister Amit Shah is ready to respond to every point regarding recent student protests.
The Government is ready for a detailed discussion in Parliament regarding the recent student protests and related issues.
Kiren Rijiju urged the Opposition to maintain order on the floor and refrain from further obstructing proceedings.

national_news.title: Protests intensify in Jharkhand after clashes between students and police during Assembly march
bullets: Protests were held over alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations in Jharkhand.
Police used water cannons, tear gas, and lathi charge to stop the protesters.
Former JPSC Chairman L. Khiangte has been arrested in connection with the protests.

national_news.title: UN expresses deep concern over recent Houthi attacks on Yemen city
bullets: UN Special Envoy for Yemen Hans Grundberg expressed deep concern over recent Houthi attacks on Mocha city.
The attacks reportedly caused civilian and military casualties, and damaged infrastructure, including port facilities.
The UN envoy called on parties to exercise maximum restraint and work on de-escalating tensions.

national_news.title: Indonesia battles wildfires across 107,000 hectares
bullets: Wildfires have burned over 107,000 hectares in Indonesia.
The largest fire is in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park in East Java, scorching 743 hectares.
Cloud-seeding operations are unlikely to be possible due to the dry season.

national_news.title: Hockey World Cup 2026 to feature new format, scrapping quarterfinal stage
bullets: The FIH Hockey Men's and Women's World Cup 2026 will be hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands from August 15 to 30.
The tournament will feature a revamped competition structure, with the top two teams from each of the two crossover pools advancing directly to the semi-finals.
India's men have been drawn alongside England, Pakistan, and Wales in the tournament.

national_news.title: India secures two medals at World Athletics U20 Championships in US
bullets: Basant Kumar Meghwal won silver in the men's high jump with a personal best clearance of 2.21 metres.
Shahnavaz Khan claimed bronze in the men's long jump with a best effort of 7.84 metres.
India's athletes made history by becoming the first Indians to win medals in the high jump and long jump at the championships.

national_news.title: TRAI Issues Direction for 1601 Series Numbers for Transactional Calls
bullets: TRAI issued Direction on use of 1601 series numbers for transactional and service calls by entities in sectors other than BFSI and Government.
Department of Communications initiated phase-wise implementation of 1601-series for Utilities, Courier and Logistics sectors entities.
Entities like electricity distribution companies, water utilities, city gas distribution companies, and LPG distribution entities will use 1601 series numbers.

national_news.title: First-ever export of mustard honey from Tripura to Dubai
bullets: The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) facilitated the export.
The export marks a significant milestone for local beekeepers by creating an opportunity to access international markets.
The shipment is expected to open new avenues for diversification of Tripura's honey value chain.

national_news.title: Thousands of bikers promote “Har Ghar Tiranga” campaign in Manipur
bullets: The bike rally was part of the nationwide 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign.
The campaign aims to promote national pride and unity.
Manipur's Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh and Home Minister Govindas Konthoujam attended the rally.

national_news.title: All India Radio Code of Conduct
bullets: Criticism of friendly countries is not allowed.
Anything obscene or defamatory is strictly prohibited.
Incitement to violence or anything against law and order is not tolerated.

national_news.title: AIR's News Services Division Aims to Provide News and Views to Every Dweller in the Country
bullets: News Services Division (NSD) of AIR strives to provide news and views to every dweller in the country
NSD adheres to the highest professional ethics and standards in Radio Broadcasting
The division is headed by a Director General (News) and assisted by a team of Additional Directors General

national_news.title: Government Schemes for Indian Citizens
bullets: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment is involved in designing these schemes.
Schemes aim to enhance social welfare, economic development, health, and education.
Eligibility, application processes, and benefits of each scheme are available.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Governor Attends Dr. Arvind Panagariya's Lecture Program at Bihar Lok Bhawan
bullets: Bihar Governor participated in a special lecture program at Bihar Lok Bhawan.
Chief Minister announced a wide campaign to raise awareness about organ donation.
Efforts will be made to strengthen, improve, and make education system in Bihar more student-centric.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Transfers Rs 1100 to 1.13 Crore Pensioners on Bihar Pension Day
bullets: Bihar CM transfers Rs 1100 to 1.13 crore pensioners on Bihar Pension Day
Total 1.13 crore pensioners benefited from the scheme
The move aims to provide financial support to the elderly and vulnerable sections of society

bihar_news.title: Right to Information: Key Points from Honourable Governor's Speech
bullets: The Honourable Governor of Bihar addressed the joint session of Bihar Vidhan Mandal in 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026.
Bihar is an entirely land–locked state located in the eastern part of the country.
The Governor's speeches likely covered key aspects of governance, development, and implementation of Right to Information in Bihar.
